'''Iemasa Kayumi''' (Japanese: '''家弓家正''' ''Kayumi Iemasa'') was a Japanese voice actor for {{aniseries|PTS}}.

==Biography==
Kayumi was born on October 31, 1933, in {{wp|Tokyo Prefecture}}, {{wp|Japan}}, and became an actor as an adult. He joined the {{pkmn|animated series}} during {{aniseries|DP}}, voicing [[Professor Rowan]]. Kayumi passed away on September 30, 2014, at the age of 80.
